name: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition
description: Baldur's Gate II: Enhanced Edition is a singleplayer and multiplayer isometric role-playing game in the Baldur's Gate series.

eax.problem: This is the Enhanced Edition, not the classic Baldur's Gate II, and it has no EAX.

notes: If you also own the classic Baldur's Gate II, it's a separate GOG purchase, 'Baldur's Gate 2 Complete', and that one has EAX.
